shareTitle.description: Optional event name for share captions, e.g. "Investec Developer Community Meetup". Defaults to title

status.description: draft = hidden, active = listed through the meetup date, archived = hidden from the list but links still work

theme.description: Design id = file name in content/themes (without .json)

date.description: Real calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format; active through this date in Africa/Johannesburg

venue.description: Full venue/address. Used on the badge and in captions only when venueShort is not set

venueShort.description: Optional short venue for the badge footer and share captions, e.g. "Investec Sandton". Defaults to venue

link.description: Optional full https:// link without credentials

sessionTitle.description: Ask speakers for a session title
